contracts.registered_extra_turn_givers: PaelsEye is the only registered live ShouldTakeExtraTurn override; MockExtraTurnPower is a test-only source model.
contracts.switch: After complete player end/flush/after-end hooks, take the extra player turn before any enemy turn hooks or moves. Increment player TurnNumber, not RoundNumber.
contracts.scope: Player setup and owner-side expiry run again; enemy poison, intent/move state, block clear, duration ticks, hatch and Nemesis do not advance.
contracts.first_round_plating: BeforeSideTurnStart player-side block applies on each player start in round1, including an extra turn; first enemy turn still does not reduce plating.
contracts.durations: DoubleDamage, RetainHand, Debilitate and Conqueror decrement on owner-side end; Weak/Frail/Vulnerable/Intangible/Colossus/NoBlock decrement only after enemy side. Counter amounts are durations, not a reason to remove the whole stack.
contracts.temporary_stats: Owner-side temporary stat reversal happens before the extra player turn and still uses incoming power modifiers. Ritual and recovery preserve owner power application order.
contracts.reflect: Owner-side start decrements Reflect, including an extra player turn; enemy Reflect does not tick on the player extra turn.

limitations: Finite independently implemented source contracts; no installed-game comparisons or complete interaction certification.
Existing saves without an explicit source round retain their legacy turn-derived round until taking a newly modeled extra turn.
